title: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 ques

translated_title: 活跃上下文图：面向企业数据推理的持续语义学习
translated_abstract: 企业AI如今已经能够执行分析、报告和数据驱动的工作流，但其依赖的数据基础仍然难以落地运营：业务含义、关系、指标定义和报告惯例在数据库模式中缺失，并散落在缺乏文档的系统和员工经验性知识中。我们提出了活跃上下文图，这是一个持续学习的上下文层，无需复制或转换底层数据仓库，即可使现有企业数据可被AI直接使用。LCG从数据本身引导出基础语义与关系，构建一个在服务查询过程中索引业务上下文的概念图，从经过验证的结果中写入持久的语义学习，并在后续结果与先前路径相矛盾时撤回或重新获得上下文。我们通过text-to-SQL这一核心数据推理任务，在三个BIRD数据库的迁移感知划分（共499个问题）上对LCG进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出活跃上下文图，这是一种无需复制或转换数据仓库即可让企业现有数据直接服务于AI的持续学习语义层，它通过从数据中引导语义、构建概念图索引业务上下文、基于验证结果持久化或撤回语义知识，显著提升text-to-SQL等数据推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned semantic layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without copying or transforming the warehouse, by bootstrapping semantics from the data, indexing business context in a concept graph, and persisting or withdrawing semantic learnings based on verified outcomes.
